title: The Bait
text: The quarry is too wary to be caught by chance. It has circled your camp three nights running, leaving nothing but tracks. The old hunters say it might come to bait, if the bait were living, warm and a little hurt.

options.label: The hardiest plays the bait, bleeding a little into the dark to draw it out.

outcomes.text: It comes out of the dark for the warm one, hungry and careless. The rest of you are waiting for it.

options.label: Buy a goat off a hermit and stake it out, sparing your own blood.

outcomes.text: It works. The goat minds less than you do, and nobody watches what becomes of it.

options.label: Wait it out, however long it takes. Even a wary thing grows hungry.

outcomes.text: Days pass, the nights longer still. It comes at last in its own time and on its own terms, when you are at your most tired.
